about: PRH (Finnish Patent and Registration Office) open-data APIs: search and look up Finnish companies (YTJ), browse trade register notices, and fetch digital (XBRL) financial statements.

commands.summary: Search Finnish companies (YTJ) by name, location, company form, main business line and registration date range

params.name: name
params.description: Company name. Matches current, previous, parallel and auxiliary trade names.

params.name: location
params.description: Town or city (post office) of the company address

params.name: businessId
params.description: Exact Finnish business ID (Y-tunnus), e.g. 0112038-9

params.name: companyForm
params.description: Company form, as an abbreviation or numeric code from list-code-descriptions code=YRMU, e.g. OY or 16 (osakeyhtiö), OYJ or 17, AOY or 2

params.name: mainBusinessLine
params.description: Main business line as a TOL 2008 industry code or prefix, e.g. 62 (computer programming)

params.name: registrationDateStart
params.description: Earliest company registration date, ISO date YYYY-MM-DD

params.name: registrationDateEnd
params.description: Latest company registration date, ISO date YYYY-MM-DD

params.name: page
params.description: Result page number (starts at 1)

commands.summary: Get full YTJ basic details of one company by business ID (Y-tunnus)

params.name: businessId
params.description: Finnish business ID (Y-tunnus), format 1234567-8

commands.summary: Get a company's trade register details and its list of registered notices by business ID

params.name: businessId
params.description: Exact Finnish business ID (Y-tunnus), format 1234567-8

commands.summary: Get one registered trade register notice by its record year and number (record number YYYY/NNNNNN)

params.name: year
params.description: Record year, the part before the slash in recordNumber, e.g. 2026

params.name: number
params.description: Record number, the part after the slash in recordNumber, e.g. 178844

commands.summary: Search companies with registered trade register notices by entry code and notice registration date range

params.name: entryCode
params.description: Notice entry code, e.g. HAL (board/management change) or VAL (authorised signatories)

params.name: noticeRegistrationDateStart
params.description: Earliest notice registration date, ISO date YYYY-MM-DD

params.name: noticeRegistrationDateEnd
params.description: Latest notice registration date, ISO date YYYY-MM-DD

params.name: page
params.description: Result page number (starts at 1)

commands.summary: Get a YTJ code list (e.g. company forms YRMU) as tab-separated text: abbreviation, code, description

params.name: code
params.description: Code list identifier, e.g. YRMU (company forms)

params.name: lang
params.description: Description language

commands.summary: List the fiscal periods for which a company has digital (XBRL) financial statement data

params.name: businessId
params.description: Finnish business ID (Y-tunnus), format 1234567-8

commands.summary: Get one company's digital financial statement (XBRL income statement and balance sheet facts) for a fiscal period end date

params.name: businessId
params.description: Finnish business ID (Y-tunnus), format 1234567-8

params.name: financialDate
params.description: Fiscal period end date, ISO date YYYY-MM-DD (see list-financial-periods)

commands.summary: List all companies that have digital financial statements for a given fiscal period end date

params.name: financialDate
params.description: Fiscal period end date, ISO date YYYY-MM-DD

params.name: page
params.description: Result page number (100 results per page). Paging was not verified.

commands.summary: List filed digital financial statements (businessId, period end, registration date), optionally by registration date range

params.name: registrationDateStart
params.description: Earliest statement registration date, ISO date YYYY-MM-DD. The API appeared to ignore this filter.

params.name: registrationDateEnd
params.description: Latest statement registration date, ISO date YYYY-MM-DD. The API appeared to ignore this filter.

params.name: page
params.description: Result page number (100 results per page). Paging was not verified.

commands.summary: Get the OpenAPI (YAML) specification of one PRH open-data API, including all parameters and code meanings

params.name: api
params.description: Which API's spec to fetch

params.name: lang
params.description: Language of the descriptions
